title: Differentiation Quiz 1
instructions: Write maths answers with the keypad. Any equal form is accepted.
Every question has a trap. Slow down at the signs.

questions.question: Differentiate $x^{4}$.
questions.explanation: $4x^{3}$. Watch out: reduce the power by one, not by two.

questions.question: Differentiate $\dfrac1x$.
questions.explanation: Write $x^{-1}$: $-x^{-2}=-\dfrac{1}{x^2}$. Watch out: the answer is negative.

questions.question: Differentiate $\sqrt{x}$.
questions.explanation: $x^{1/2}$ gives $\dfrac12x^{-1/2}=\dfrac{1}{2\sqrt x}$. Watch out: the exponent becomes $-\dfrac12$.

questions.question: Differentiate $\cos x$.
questions.explanation: $\dfrac{d}{dx}\cos x=-\sin x$. Watch out: the minus sign.

questions.question: Differentiate $\ln x$.
questions.explanation: $\dfrac{d}{dx}\ln x=\dfrac1x$. Watch out: this holds for $x>0$.

questions.question: What is $\dfrac{d}{dx}e^{x}$?
questions.explanation: The exponential is its own derivative. Watch out: the power rule does not apply to $e^x$.

questions.question: The derivative of a constant is $0$.
questions.explanation: A constant has a flat graph. Watch out: this is why $x^2+7$ and $x^2$ have the same derivative.

questions.question: Find the gradient of $y=x^{3}$ at $x=2$.
questions.explanation: $y'=3x^2=12$ at $x=2$. Watch out: substitute into the derivative, not into $y$.

questions.question: Match each function with its derivative.
questions.explanation: These are the standard derivatives. Watch out: only $\cos x$ gets a minus sign.
